ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted sharply with low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) forming the perimeter and internal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white central field across both lobes. Low-intensity black perimeter banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Series of parallel, low-intensity linear streaks on the distal-superior regions of both lobes. Discrete low-intensity pixel clusters (mottling) observed on the mid-lower quadrant of the right lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, medium-amplitude serrations present along the continuous trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude peaks increasing in height towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow an upward-curving convex trajectory from the peduncle to the tips; trailing edges exhibit an irregular convex sweep from tips toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, roughly circular dark pixel clusters (spots) concentrated in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple, parallel, unaligned linear low-intensity pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper-distal edges of both lobes, notably four distinct parallel lines on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the superior distal regions of both lobes; discrete spotting pattern on the lower right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical distribution of linear distal markings relative to the median notch.
